body.p: The primary reason to build a desktop is to get a system tailored to your needs as a user. While some prebuilt systems can offer good value for the cost, they still won’t match your needs as well as a properly researched home-built computer will. Building a desktop has become easier and more affordable over the years, with many modern builds requiring little more than a Phillips screwdriver and your hands to assemble.

However, while anyone can build their own desktop, not everyone needs to do so. If all you need is basic web browsing and an office suite then a laptop or pre-built desktop would cover your needs for less money. Moreover, a prebuilt laptop provides the mobility that your built desktop cannot. And if your needs are simple, the cost of a basic laptop might be comparable to building a desktop.
In general, if you need more power and flexibility than a basic office PC and don’t mind being mostly tethered to a desk, then building a desktop PC is the right choice.
